runtime_hook: UI Text Size slider + Accessibility readout
player_effect: Player can queue and apply UI text size independently from subtitle size.
UI text size survives quitting, reopening, and resuming any coding-language save slot.
HUD, pause, tutorial, terminal, journal, minimap, skill tree, save slots, fast travel, damage feedback, victory, and death screens read a clamped 0.80x to 1.75x UI scale.
Subtitle font size remains controlled only by the Subtitle Size slider and does not inherit the UI Text Size slider.
Accessibility reset returns both subtitle and UI text scale to 1.0x while preserving the separate audio mix controls.
